image_description: A low-angle shot of a traffic light assembly against a cloudy sky. The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal head mounted on a horizontal cantilever arm attached to a vertical pole. The signal head appears to have three lenses, with the top one illuminated red. There is a secondary rectangular sign or sensor box below the main signal. In the background, there are trees, utility poles, and buildings.
